skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand key concepts related to investment development and project investment development.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the necessity of project-based investment
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the necessity of project-based investment when implementing investment development activities.
Master the research process (research levels) of a project and the organization of project preparation.
Master and practice the analysis of components required during the project preparation process.
Master and practice financial and economic evaluation methods for projects.
Master and practice comparative selection methods for optimal investment options.
Develop problem analysis skills, systematic thinking skills, and the ability to identify and choose investment opportunities.
Develop the ability to gather information and write specific project proposals.
Recognize social context and adapt to globalized environments, be responsible towards society, and comply with regulations and laws.
Develop self-study skills, the ability to work independently, and teamwork spirit.
